BrainShark / Web & mobile product

Find, learn and move forward.

A more consistent sales-training experience across web and mobile.

UX/UI Lead DesignerJuan Carvajal
THE STARTING POINT

BrainShark

The platform connects training, content creation and coaching for sales teams. Different patterns across product areas made it harder to learn.

PROJECT CONTEXT
01 / The challenge02 / The solution03 / Decisions04 / The impact
01

The challenge

Resolve fragmented navigation, inconsistent patterns and difficulty finding training materials.

02

The solution

As UX/UI Lead, I worked with product and engineering in Boston. Contextual interviews, focus groups and participatory workshops informed personas, journeys, information architecture and contextual search.

03

Decisions that make the difference

01

Research the real context of sales representatives and trainers.

02

Organize content around needs and tasks.

03

Keep familiar patterns across platforms.

04 / The impact

One experience across web, iOS and Android

A web redesign and iOS and Android apps with more consistent navigation and components. The case describes easier content access and use without quantifying those outcomes.
